description: Renovation work at Waterfront Station, the landmark 1914 neo-classical Canadian Pacific Railway terminal at the foot of Granville Street — today the hub joining SeaBus, SkyTrain and West Coast Express beneath one coffered concourse ceiling.

Recovered drawings detail the restoration of the grand concourse bays along Cordova Street — new glazing, painted steel and restored plasterwork within the original arched openings — while period photographs record the concourse interior and the fully glazed elevator added to make the heritage station accessible.
note: Drawings and photographs recovered from the studio's original website and archive via the Internet Archive.
